### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **8** package(s): `@objectstack/cli`, `@objectstack/core`, `@objectstack/plugin-audit`, `@objectstack/plugin-security`, `@objectstack/service-mailbox`, `@objectstack/service-storage`, `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/verify`, touching **85** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **11** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/cli/package.json`, `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/parent-record-read-gate.ts`, `packages/services/service-mailbox/LICENSE`, …), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**74** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json df7a137923be503bf6fea15a6fc944d3ba06df6f`.

⛔ **14** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **11** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/cli/package.json`, `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/parent-record-read-gate.ts`, `packages/services/service-mailbox/LICENSE`, …) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **1** cross-cutting symbol(s) contributed no route anchor: `isSystem (5 routes)`
- **1** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `sys_user (literal, 40 pages)`
- **14** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **156** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json df7a137923be503bf6fea15a6fc944d3ba06df6f` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `2d0ee5ddd39af53b73d3e82d42ef496402f4f67d` — the merge of head `204aa2e8d4ced58a1f6bbf7df3a2381b33ac5780` into base `df7a137923be503bf6fea15a6fc944d3ba06df6f`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 2d0ee5ddd39af53b73d3e82d42ef496402f4f67d && git checkout 2d0ee5ddd39af53b73d3e82d42ef496402f4f67d
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin df7a137923be503bf6fea15a6fc944d3ba06df6f 204aa2e8d4ced58a1f6bbf7df3a2381b33ac5780 && git checkout -B drift-repro df7a137923be503bf6fea15a6fc944d3ba06df6f && git merge --no-ff 204aa2e8d4ced58a1f6bbf7df3a2381b33ac5780

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json df7a137923be503bf6fea15a6fc944d3ba06df6f
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs df7a137923be503bf6fea15a6fc944d3ba06df6f` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `204aa2e8d4ced58a1f6bbf7df3a2381b33ac5780`
Local-runs: none

Isolated at-tier subagent of `domain:spec` seat 1 (#6017), reading at 2026-10-12T15:55Z. Inputs: card #22870 (its body and all 16 comments: the stage-0 report `6115941082`, the ruling `6116489638`, the claim `6118835291`, the dev reports `6120288712` and `6126279669`, the seat's review `6124120437` with its in-place correction), PR #22993 (its body, its 58-file list, the diff against the merge base `df7a137923`), and the 50 check-runs on the head. Nothing was built, run or re-run; file contents beyond the diff were read with `git show` at the head and at the merge base.

**Head and checks.** The REST `head.sha` equals the brief's sha. Check-runs on it: 50 — 43 `success`, 7 `skipped` (`Console Pin Gate`, `Dogfood Verify CLI`, the dogfood matrix placeholder, `Packed-tarball smoke (opt-in)`, `Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL)`, and the re-triggered `Auto Label` and `Check PR Size`), 0 failure, 0 in progress. Of the seven required contexts six are `success` and `Temporal Conformance` is `skipped`. `mergeable: true`, `mergeable_state: unstable`, `draft: true`, `auto_merge: null`; 2,739 additions and 152 deletions, 2,891 changed lines, under 3,000.

### ① Derived judgments

Published schema (`packages/spec/src/**`), four accept-set widenings, each RIGHT:
1. `security/capabilities.ts`: `PLATFORM_CAPABILITIES` gains `manage_mailboxes`, `scope: 'org'`, with label and description. Ruling `6116489638` Q4 → A as written, in the `view_all_audit_log` precedent's shape. Its readers land in the same diff — both gates (`MAILBOX_ADMIN_CAPABILITY`) and `sys_mailbox.requiredPermissions` — so declared = enforced holds for the name.
2. `identity/eval-user.zod.ts`: `ADMIN_FULL_ACCESS_CAPABILITIES.systemPermissions` gains `manage_mailboxes`; platform administrators hold it by default. RIGHT (Q4 → A).
3. `kernel/platform-capabilities.ts`: `mailbox` joins `PLATFORM_CAPABILITY_TOKENS` and `PLATFORM_CAPABILITY_PROVIDERS` (`@objectstack/service-mailbox`, `open`), and not the always-on slate. RIGHT (ADR-0029 D2; stage-0 §4 PR 2).
4. `system/constants/platform-object-names.ts`: the `service-mailbox` group names exactly the three objects the plugin registers. RIGHT.
No spec export is removed or narrowed; the dev reports no spec shard moved, and `TypeScript Type Check` (the job that runs `check:generated`) is `success`.

Other public surfaces:
5. `@objectstack/core` gains `resolveReadableParentIds` and the `ReadableParentIdsEngine` type at its root entry (`src/index.ts` re-exports `./security/index.js`), plus the `CAPABILITY_PROVIDERS.mailbox` row. RIGHT: stage-0 §3.4 said a third consumer hoists the probe rather than copying it; all three consumers already depend on core; the structural engine type keeps core free of an engine dependency.
6. `@objectstack/plugin-audit`: the exported `resolveReadableParentIds` in `comment-access-hooks.ts` is deleted. Verified at the merge base: the package index re-exports only `installCommentAccessHooks`, `installCommentReadVisibility`, `parseCommentThreadId` and types from that module, and the `exports` map has `.` alone, so the symbol was never in the published accept set and this is not a narrowing. `parent-record-read-gate.ts` and `comment-access-hooks.ts` now import it from core. RIGHT.
7. `@objectstack/service-storage`: the private copy in `attachment-access-hooks.ts` is deleted and the import points at core. RIGHT (the two bodies were measured byte-identical; the core body in the diff is that body under a structural engine type).
8. `@objectstack/plugin-security`: `organization_admin.systemPermissions` gains `manage_mailboxes`, and the derived `organization_admin_no_bypass` carries it; the six grant goldens move with it in both postures, single and walled. RIGHT (Q4 → A).
9. `@objectstack/service-mailbox` (new, 17.7.0, in the fixed group): `MailboxServicePlugin` (manifest `com.objectstack.service.mailbox`, `dependencies: ['com.objectstack.engine.objectql']`) registers `sys_mailbox`, `sys_mail_message` and `sys_mail_association`; the root entry exports the plugin, the objects, the gate functions, constants and types. RIGHT per ruling Q2 → C3 and ADR-0029 D1/D2.
10. `@objectstack/cli` and `@objectstack/verify` depend on the new package so `serve` and `bootStack` can mount the provider; the cli inventory gains three ADR-0131 rows (fate `attribution`; the message anchored to its mailbox, the association to its message) and the identity pin a `mailbox` row. RIGHT.
11. The showcase declares `requires: [..., 'mailbox']` (a private example). RIGHT (stage-0 §4).

The objects against the build sheet (stage-0 §3.1 and §3.2, the claim's identity half), each RIGHT:
- `sys_mail_message`: `isSystem`, `managedBy: 'engine-owned'`, `enable: { apiMethods: ['get', 'list'], files: true }`, `nameField` and `titleFormat` on `subject`, the four highlight fields, and the 18 §3.1 columns at the §3.1 types and bounds (`message_id` 998; addresses 320 and 4,000; `dedupe_key` 128, required; `received_at` required; `association_state` a select defaulting to `unassociated`; `from_address` and `subject` optional; no Bcc). `body_html` is `textarea`, never `html`. Indexes: `(mailbox_id, dedupe_key)` unique per organization, `(association_state, received_at)`, `(mailbox_id, received_at)`.
- `sys_mail_association`: `mail_message_id` lookup; the ActivityPointer pair `object_name` / `record_id` (`referenceVia: 'object_name'`, 255 so the index is expressible); `matched_address` 320, `matched_field` 255, `matched_by` select `ingest` / `rematch`. Unique `(mail_message_id, object_name, record_id)` per organization, plus `(object_name, record_id)`. `engine-owned`, `get` and `list`.
- `sys_mailbox`: `name`, `address` (email, 320), `owner_user_id` lookup `sys_user`; `requiredPermissions: ['manage_mailboxes']`; `engine-owned`, `get` and `list`. The connector half stays with #22871.
- No `member_default` grant is added (stage-0 §2.4: explicit-allow).

The two read gates (`mail-read-visibility.ts`), on the security posture the ruling and the card's acceptance require:
- **Restricted pool default — RIGHT.** The message filter serves a candidate when (a) the caller holds `manage_mailboxes` in its resolved `systemPermissions` (then no filter at all), (b) the caller's `userId` owns the row's mailbox (`sys_mailbox.owner_user_id`, read as the system), or (c) one of the row's `sys_mail_association` rows names a record `resolveReadableParentIds` answers readable under the caller's own context. A pool row has no association, so only (a) and (b) serve it. The association filter serves a row under (a) or when its own pair is readable. This is stage-0 §3.4 and ruling Q4 → A as written.
- **Fail-closed — RIGHT.** The pre-scan runs as the system at `MAIL_GATE_SCAN_LIMIT` (2,000, the `PARENT_GATE_SCAN_LIMIT` value) in the caller's order; rows beyond the cap never enter the emitted `$in`, and a `warn` says so. A malformed pair, a mail object named as the parent (`MAIL_OBJECTS`), a non-machine name or an unreadable or unknown parent contributes nothing; zero visible rows emits the deny-all sentinel; a thrown filter computation ANDs the deny-all sentinel and logs. The filter is ANDed into the caller's WHERE, never replacing it, so the caller's own read still passes the object grant and the organization wall.
- **Coverage — RIGHT.** Registered as object-scoped middleware on `find`, `findOne`, `count` and `aggregate`, so `total` agrees with the rows (pinned: the reader's list `total` 1, the owner's `total` 3).
- **System and context-less reads un-narrowed — RIGHT by precedent.** The entry test (not a read op, no `ast`, no `context`, or `context.isSystem` → pass through) is the shape of the activity, ledger, comment and attachment gates at this head; the `isSystem` bypass is row 47 on `content/docs/permissions/system-context.mdx`, and the census gate inside `Lint · docs & code guards` is `success`.
- **Exemption and holders — RIGHT.** `manage_mailboxes` is read from `context.systemPermissions`, the channel the authorization resolver stamps and the ledger gate's `view_all_audit_log` exemption reads. Holders by default: platform administrators (`ADMIN_FULL_ACCESS_CAPABILITIES`) and organization administrators (`organization_admin` and its no-bypass derivative); every other position by explicit grant only. The dogfood fixture grants it explicitly to `holder`, and the seeded platform admin reads the pool as a default holder.
- **Owner limb — RIGHT.** `sys_mailbox.owner_user_id` equals the caller's `userId`; the owner is served every message of its mailbox (pinned: the pool `200`, `total` 3) but not the directory itself (pinned: `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` on `sys_mailbox`; the holder `200`).
- **The `404` and `403` answers — RIGHT.** An ordinary member holding object read on the message reads the pool row as `404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND` (the card's acceptance pin, status and code both asserted; existence non-disclosure per stage-0 §2.4), and a message associated only with a record it cannot read likewise; a member with no object grant is refused `403 PERMISSION_DENIED` at the object, which proves the pin's refusal is the gate's. The dev's ablation (gates left unregistered → 4 of 9 red, `expected 200 to be 404`, `total` 2 not 1) shows the pin is load-bearing; the suite runs under `Dogfood Regression Gate`, `success` on this head.
- **Boot wiring — RIGHT.** The gates install on `kernel:ready`; an engine without the middleware seam logs at `error` with the consequence (the pool unrestricted) and the remedy, per the degradation rule, and the unit test pins the message.

Generated and derived files, each RIGHT: the tenancy census (87 registered, 52 in reach; three new `in` rows on `organization_id`); the four locale bundles with their source-hash companions wired through `withSourceFallback`; the i18n coverage baseline entry at 0; the lockstep package count 70 → 71 and `llms.txt` 69 → 70; the `.changeset/config.json` fixed group; system-context row 47 with the later rows renumbered and the census script's `row 60` and `rows 1–62` references and self-test expectations moved with them; the inventory rows; the grant goldens.

The governed edit, `docs/adr/0139-…` line 63: one line, in which only the anchor path inside the backticks moves from `packages/plugins/plugin-audit/src/comment-access-hooks.ts#resolveReadableParentIds` to `packages/core/src/security/readable-parent-ids.ts#resolveReadableParentIds`. No prose changes; the sentence is location-neutral; no decision in ADR-0139 (D1–D6 declare the engine leaf and implement nothing) is moved. At the head no other file in the tree names the old anchor spelling and no `scripts/adr-anchors/` entry names the symbol; `Lint · docs & code guards`, the job the seat measured red on `5866e6e1f` for this anchor, is `success`. RIGHT — and it puts `docs/adr/**`, a `GOVERNED_TIER_H` register row, in the diff.

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/22870-service-mailbox.md`: `@objectstack/spec` minor, `@objectstack/service-mailbox` minor, `@objectstack/core` minor, `@objectstack/plugin-security` minor, `@objectstack/plugin-audit` patch, `@objectstack/service-storage` patch, `@objectstack/cli` patch, `@objectstack/verify` patch. Checked against the diff: every published package whose shipped source moves is named (the two other packages touched, `@objectstack/dogfood` and `@objectstack/example-showcase`, are `private: true`); the four `minor`s are the four surfaces that widen (①.1–5, 8 and 9); the four `patch`es change no published export (①.6, 7 and 10). Nothing narrows: the one deleted export was never addressable through plugin-audit's `exports` map, so no ADR-0087 disposition is owed and `check-changeset-no-major` has nothing to refuse (`Check Changeset` is `success`). The changeset's one bullet per package matches the diff.

Clause-②: `yes (widening)`, in the PR body and in the changeset body, matching the claim and the ruling; `yes` takes at least `minor` on spec, which it has. Level RIGHT.

### ③ Boundary flags

Dev report `6120288712` (head `76b1da0da`):
- deviations: the files outside the claim's surface — each judged above with the reader that needs it (①.10, the dogfood suite's home beside the other showcase boots, the census row, the package counts, the baseline, the goldens): answered. The worktree re-creation — process only, no diff effect. The missing README — closed by the second round (`packages/services/service-mailbox/README.md` is in the diff and states only what ships, with its "nothing ingests mail yet" warning). Zero label writes — consistent with the dispatch. The commit-trailer form — AGENTS.md's; not a contract matter.
- `open_questions`: none.
- out of scope: the ADR-0139 prose pointer — superseded by the seat's in-place correction in `6124120437` (the symbol-anchor gate does read it) and closed by the pointer edit judged above. The `packages/spec/liveness/README.md` field-cell sentence — not carried; prose no gate reads; not owed by this PR, and it stays the note PR 1's acceptance already carries.

Dev report `6126279669` (this head):
- deviations: the PR body replacements (a) to (e) and the `维护者速读(草稿)` section — all applied in the body as read (the verification record at `204aa2e8d`, 155 gates, 2,891 lines and 58 files, the resolver bullet naming the re-anchor and Tier H, the two added list items, the section verbatim). The worktree — no bearing. The lint job's 57 steps run through a runner after one refused batch command — local evidence only; the gate verdict is `Lint · docs & code guards` `success` on this head. The seat's orders taken as data, and the merge — right: the head is a merge of `origin/main` with the conflicts re-derived, and CI ran on it.
- `open_questions`: none.
- out of scope, class a: `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derives gate families from touched paths, so a diff that deletes an ADR-anchored symbol without touching `docs/adr/**` never derives the symbol-anchor family; CI caught it on `5866e6e1f`. **Escalated** to the dispatching seat as a tooling finding to file (a named producer; reach: every PR that moves or removes an anchored symbol). Nothing in this diff is owed for it. The corrected "no anchor gate reads it" line — closed by the body replacement.

The seat's review `6124120437` owed the merge and the README before this review: both are on the head. Its correction asked for the pointer alone, with no prose change, and that is what the diff carries.

One note from the ADR this PR touches, **escalated, not a finding against the diff**: ADR-0139 D4 and its E5/E7 cards enumerate six probe consumers as read on `origin/main` `d8830c28`; the two mail gates are a seventh and an eighth consumer of today's bounded system pre-scan, the ruled §3.4 shape chosen with the ledger gate as precedent. The record implements nothing and forbids no new consumer (D6 leaves even a seventh open), so the PR is consistent with it, but the E7 switch card should name the mail gates, or they stay on the probe after the others move. For the seat to route to the `domain:engine` lane.

Landing: this record satisfies the contract-review requirement a `Clause-②: yes` diff owes, and a PASS record is a Tier S carrier only. The diff touches `docs/adr/**`, a Tier H row, so the PR lands only on an authorized APPROVED review by a `GOVERNED_APPROVERS` account, after which the owning seat lands it through the queue; until then it stays draft and unarmed (Prime Directive #14). The pre-queue condition that every check on the head is green holds.

## 维护者速读

`domain:spec` seat 1 (#6017) · `os-warren` · session `session_019G5ZnRrTMiwcHG6iZM19zf` · 2026-10-12T15:57Z. This is the final version, checked by the seat against the diff it read. The draft is in the PR body.

- **改了什么**:新增 `@objectstack/service-mailbox` 能力包。应用在 `requires` 里写上 `'mailbox'` 后,平台会注册三张入站邮件系统表:
  - 邮箱目录(`sys_mailbox`);
  - 邮件镜像(`sys_mail_message`);
  - 邮件与业务记录的关联(`sys_mail_association`)。

  同时装上两道读取门,并新增能力名 `manage_mailboxes`,平台管理员和组织管理员默认持有。另外,把「判断调用者能否读某条父记录」的公共函数从两个包挪进 `@objectstack/core`,只留一份。ADR-0139 里指向它的那一个链接随之更新,ADR 正文一个字都没改。
- **为什么改**:入站邮件第一阶段(#22870)要求未匹配到任何记录的「邮件池」默认受限,只有邮箱管理员和邮箱所有者可见,不对全组织开放(裁决 Q4 → A)。现在的规则:
  - 普通成员只能读到与自己能看的记录关联的邮件。
  - 读池中邮件返回 404,按「不存在」处理,不泄露它存在。
  - 收信本身(IMAP 接入)属于 #22871,本 PR 不包含。
- **风险与代价(含回滚)**:
  - 三张表只在应用声明 `mailbox` 能力时才注册,不声明的部署零影响。
  - 公共函数挪家前后逐字节一致,附件、评论、动态、审计日志四道原有读取门的行为不变,对应 dogfood 套件全绿。
  - 代价:组织管理员默认多了一个能力。
  - 回滚:revert 本 PR 即可。目前没有任何写入方,不会留下数据。
- **席位意见**:建议批准。
  - 实现与裁决 Q4 → A 逐条一致:默认受限、失败即拒绝、计数和列表结果一致、豁免与所有者两条放行规则。
  - at-tier 契约复审 PASS(`6127813917`),CI 全绿(43 成功、7 跳过、0 失败),改动 2891 行,低于人工合并门槛。
  - 本 PR 之所以要你批,只因为它碰了 `docs/adr/**`,而那一处只是一个链接。
- **你要做的(一个动作)**:在本 PR 上点一次 **Approve**。之后由席位跑入队前检查,并走合并队列落地。
